$comment: Which language a guest reads in (sc-3790): the guest's own choice on their page, then what their browser asks for, then the host's Language for them, then the organisation's. A message has no browser, so it skips that step. packages/domain's guestLanguage and the API's GuestLanguage are both tested against these cases.

cases.name: a message follows the guest, not the organiser who sends it
a guest's choice Soirely does not offer gives way to the organisation's
the guest's choice wins over everything
a browser asking for pt-BR gets Portuguese
the browser's first language Soirely offers
a browser asking only for de falls through to the host's Language
with no host's Language, the organisation's
a browser asking for English sees English
a choice Soirely does not offer is passed over
an organisation language Soirely does not offer is English
